response.text:
I can’t give an exact number from that chart. With only axis ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15 and no data labels or source data, the West Q3 bar can only be located to the interval between $10M and $15M.

If you want a rough visual estimate: it looks roughly in the middle of that interval (≈ $12–13M), but that is only an approximation, not an exact value.

To get the exact value, provide one of:
- the original dataset used to make the chart,
- the chart’s data labels or underlying spreadsheet,
- or a high-resolution image plus the chart source so the numeric value can be read or confirmed.
